validity_findings.finding: M1_cross_site for Mind2Web 0.8182 is computed from synthetic input instance_count=10 (m2w_m1_data site_types cross_website_pair 10) with max_expected=12. This 10 is not measured from dataset; provenance admits Mind2Web analysis based on paper/README not dataset inspection. Empirical mean websites/domain =137/31=4.42 gives M1=(4.42-1)/11=0.311 <0.5 threshold. Max per-domain may be 10 but median/mean is the relevant instance count for cross-site pair density. Using max inflates M1 by 0.507 and single-handedly makes M4>0 and distributed SURVIVES possible. No verification that same mechanism appears across those websites.

validity_findings.finding: Frozen decision_rule requires >=1 benchmark M1>=0.5 AND >=1 benchmark M2>=0.5 AND >=1 benchmark M3 true (distributed). Producer reports SURVIVES_CURRENT_TEST because M1 from WebArena/VisualWebArena/Mind2Web, M2 from WebArena/Mind2Web/AgentBench, M3 from Mind2Web. However M4 composite (M1*M2*M3) is 0.0 for WebArena shopping (M3 false) and 0.0 for VisualWebArena/AgentBench, only Mind2Web M4=0.5318 under optimistic M1. No single benchmark simultaneously provides cross-site structure, parameterization, AND novelty splits at task-family level without manual split construction for WebArena. Report recommendation WebArena+Mind2Web complementary acknowledges this but decision label SURVIVES overstates readiness: Mind2Web alone must carry all three and its M1 is inflated per VF1. Under corrected M1=0.31, even distributed criterion's M4 ceiling collapses to 0.20 (0.31*0.65) and no family has strong composite.

validity_findings.finding: Spec measurement_validity states novelty fraction splits must be definable by task instance where same mechanism appears in both train and test on different instances. Mind2Web official splits are by task/website/domain, not by mechanism instance. Producer validity_notes correctly scores WebArena M3 false because no official instance-level splits exist, but scores Mind2Web true based on official website split. Whether website split guarantees same mechanism on both sides is unresolved (producer unresolved 2). No verification that held-out websites contain same search/book mechanisms as train. For C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, controlled novelty fraction measurement is therefore not demonstrated, only split existence.

claim_ceiling: SURVIVES as distributed structural-documentation survey only: public documentation suggests WebArena shopping provides imposed cross-site pairs (12 stores sharing platform, M1=1.0) with template-like parameterization (heuristic M2=0.8) but no official instance-level splits (M3 false, manual splits required); VisualWebArena inherits same cross-site but lower heuristic parameterization (M2=0.3) due to visual grounding; Mind2Web provides official instance/website/domain splits enabling novelty-fraction splits (M3 true) with heuristic cross-site 0.31-0.82 depending on websites-per-domain definition and heuristic parameterization 0.60-0.65, yielding composite M4 0.20-0.53 under optimistic assumptions. No direct dataset inspection, no verified same-mechanism co-occurrence across sites, no demonstrated instance-level split with mechanism overlap, and transformation costs inherited not measured. Maximum justified: benchmark documentation identifies complementary task families (WebArena shopping for cross-site pairs, Mind2Web cross-website for splits) that *could* support C-LLM-INHERIT/C-CROSSSITE/C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY experiment design pending dataset-level verification of mechanism sharing, duplication fraction (996 vs 812), and parameterization prevalence; not a runnable ranked suitability validated for SPIDER execution.
